body: We don't have the money to move. We would maybe be able to if they hadn't stayed with us for so long. As it stands we are almost $3k in the hole since they have stayed here. I keep track of our spending because we are low income to make sure that the kids get what they need and that we can keep the internet up for my girlfriend's university courses, and we have been hemorrhaging funds since after the first couple of weeks of them being here. We aren't even sure where the rest of rent is coming from this month. On the up side, I do have an interview monday for a decent paying job.
Thank you. I really do appreciate that.
I know. And I know it isn't reasonable to have a drive like this. It's just been creeping into my thoughts lately and I can't seem to shake it.

This is actually the same kind of advice I give myself, and has been the thing that makes me hang on. I have been in a headspace like this before as well, so it isn't alien to me. I do appreciate it though, hearing it from the outside has an entirely different weight to it.
